summary: Mobile-only frontend testing on Expo web preview. Group Avatars (create + display + admin edit) worked end-to-end. Signup Onboarding UI wired correctly but the redemption path is BLOCKED because DEVOS100 is now expired (backend GET /api/launch/code/DEVOS100 returns {state:'expired'} and POST /api/launch/code/redeem returns 400 code_expired). Persona/finish steps could not be exercised. Also flagged a minor UX gap: redeem-error surfaces the raw backend slug 'code_expired' instead of a humanised message.

ui_bugs.issue: redeem-error shows raw backend slug 'code_expired' instead of a friendly string like 'This code has expired.' The 'Check' flow already renders a nicer 'This code is expired.' — the submit path should reuse the same humanised text.

action_items: BLOCKER FOR RE-TEST: Reset / bump the remaining count on invite code DEVOS100 (or provide a fresh valid code) so the full Redeem → Onboarding → persona-student → onboarding-project-name → onboarding-finish → /(tabs) flow can be validated on mobile. Right now the code is exhausted.

Minor: In app/(auth)/redeem.tsx, translate backend error codes (e.g. 'code_expired', 'code_exhausted', 'email_taken') into human-friendly strings before setting them into `error`, mirroring the 'This code is <state>.' phrasing already used after Check.
critical_code_review_comments: onboarding.tsx `finish()` swallows API errors and still routes to /(tabs) — a failed POST /api/chats or PATCH /api/user/onboarding is silently treated as success. Consider surfacing a toast so users know onboarding didn't persist.

GroupAvatarPicker.tsx: on web preview `ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync` cannot open a native picker (expected, per PRD). No fallback message shown — a tap on 'Upload photo' on web silently no-ops. Consider a Platform.OS==='web' hint or wire an <input type='file'/> shim for parity.

success_rate.frontend: Group Avatars 100% (create + display + edit) · Onboarding 40% (redeem UI verified, post-redeem persona/finish not reachable — blocked by expired invite code)

seed_data_creation: Created one group chat 'QA Group 1786032651' (chat id feb9f8d9-2c8a-4337-9afa-3a4d34a60b78) via demo login as Amit Patel. Avatar was set to #34D399 (green people icon) on create then updated to #60A5FA via PATCH /api/chats/{id}/avatar in the admin edit modal.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Group Avatars mobile flow is fully green — testIDs group-avatar-picker, group-avatar-upload, group-color-row, group-color-<hex>, group-name-input, group-create-btn, chat-header-avatar, group-avatar-edit-modal, group-avatar-edit-save all work; PATCH /api/chats/{id}/avatar returns fresh chat and header re-renders. Onboarding UI wiring (redeem screen + persona/step2 screens) looks correct in code but was not exercised end-to-end because DEVOS100 is expired. Once E1 refills the code, re-run: goto /redeem → fill DEVOS100 + fresh email + Testpass$123 → Claim access → assert onboarding-step-persona visible → tap persona-student → fill onboarding-project-name → tap onboarding-finish → expect landing on /chat/<id> or /(tabs) with user.onboarding_completed=true; then reload and assert onboarding-step-persona no longer shows.
rca of the issue: Redeem submit fails at the API layer: GET /api/launch/code/DEVOS100 → 200 {state:'expired'}, POST /api/launch/code/redeem → 400 {detail:'code_expired'}. Root cause is data (invite code exhausted from prior iterations), not the mobile client. The mobile Redeem screen surfaces the error correctly via redeem-error testID.
